title: Compare E2F1, PATZ1 and TP73 motif curves at the human ΔNp73 TSS

graphics.caption: The TP73 annotated-start inventory retains all five starts and marks the P1/TAp73 row missing_flanks instead of silently padding or hiding it.
The approved 701 bp DeltaNp73 window before scoring, with aligned local, genomic and TSS-relative rulers and transcript context but no local motif curves.
Locally computed TP73, E2F1 and PATZ1 motif-score lanes; each lane retains its own scale and score kind, so curve heights are not cross-factor rankings.

catalog.notes: Offline real-locus native TSS walkthrough on the retained public TP73 RefSeq excerpt. Recovers the GenBank REGION anchor, previews all five annotated starts (the P1/TAp73 start is reported missing_flanks because the excerpt has no upstream sequence), approves only the internal ΔNp73 start at 1:3690672, then computes and exports locally scored E2F1 MA0024.3, PATZ1 MA1961.2 and TP73 MA0861.2 curves. Every step has GUI, Agent Assistant and inner-agent parity; ui open tss-view --local-score is GUI-hosted, while promoters tss-view-svg provides headless local scoring and export. Separate non-cross-calibrated scales, unavailable-not-zero bands, no occupancy or reporter claim. Publication-safe Linux/X11 screenshots were reviewed at the exact recorded display revision; native Windows and human scientific approval remain pending.
